Enabling infer_dimensions decodes image bytes to populate dimension metadata when extract_images is on

```python title="Python"
from html_to_markdown import ConversionOptions, convert

def main() -> None:
    html = '<p>With dims: <img src="data:image/png;base64,iVBORw0KGgoAAAANSUhEUgAAAAEAAAABCAYAAAAfFcSJAAAADUlEQVR42mP8/5+hHgAHggJ/PchI7wAAAABJRU5ErkJggg==" alt="pixel"></p>'
    options = ConversionOptions(extract_images=True, infer_dimensions=True)
    result = convert(html, options)
    print(result.content)

main()
```
